results.title: Analyst highlights nickel stock recommendations and sector outlook amid RKAB and HPM regulatory pressure
results.body: David Kurniawan of PT Indo Premier Sekuritas says nickel issuers remain under pressure in 2026 because of global oversupply, uncertainty over RKAB approval and new HPM regulations. Year‑to‑date, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (INCO) fell 9.57%, PT Trimegah Bangun Persada Tbk (NCKL) dropped 18.67%, PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk (MBMA) slid 11.3%, PT Central Omega Resources Tbk (DKFT) declined 8.97%, PT PAM Mineral Tbk (NICL) plunged 64.61%, while PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) posted a modest 0.63% gain. The analyst notes that integrated issuers such as ANTM and INCO have stronger resilience due to diversified portfolios and healthy capital structures. He expects the sector’s outlook to improve gradually in 2027 if RKAB approvals proceed smoothly and cost‑efficiency measures take effect.

results.title: Nickel stocks pressured by RKAB approval uncertainty and HPM regulation, PT PAM Mineral Tbk (NICL) leads declines.
results.body: The article reports that nickel stocks are under pressure due to uncertainty over RKAB approval and changes to the Harga Patokan Mineral (HPM) regulation, compounded by oversupply and stagnant global nickel prices. Year‑to‑date performance shows PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (INCO) down 11.70%, PT Trimegah Bangun Persada Tbk (NCKL) down 21.46%, PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk (MBMA) down 18.55%, PT Central Omega Resources Tbk (DKFT) down 14.84%, PT PAM Mineral Tbk (NICL) down 64.61%, and PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) down 1.25%. The analyst notes that integrated issuers such as PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) and PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (INCO) have relatively stronger resilience because of diversified portfolios and healthy capital structures. Outlook for 2027 is cautiously optimistic, contingent on smoother RKAB licensing, cost‑efficiency gains, and potential demand recovery from electric‑vehicle batteries and stainless‑steel markets.

results.title: Foreign investors net sold Rp 510.07 bn of Indonesian stocks, led by PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI)
results.body: Foreign investors recorded a net sell of Rp 510.07 bn on Monday, sending the Indonesia Composite Index (IHSG) down 0.88% to 6,384.72 points. The ten stocks with the largest foreign net outflows were PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI) (Rp 140.61 bn), PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) (Rp 139.93 bn), PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) (Rp 131.34 bn), PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (TLKM) (Rp 114.62 bn), PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk (MDKA) (Rp 32.42 bn), PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) (Rp 26.38 bn), PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Tbk (CPIN) (Rp 25.81 bn), PT Alamtri Resoruces Indonesia Tbk (ADRO) (Rp 22.32 bn), PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk (BBNI) (Rp 21.98 bn), and PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk (ENRG) (Rp 16.65 bn). Overall market activity was high, with 26.78 billion shares traded for a total value of Rp 11.77 trillion. Sectorally, infrastructure fell 1.38% while transport rose 0.55%, health gained 0.21% and property remained flat.

results.title: IHSG down 0.27% as foreign investors sell shares, with PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) and PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (TPIA) among the most traded stocks
results.body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) fell 0.27% to 6,423.51 points in the first session on Monday 21 September, as foreign investors recorded a net sell of Rp216.24 billion. Total transaction value on the exchange was Rp5.74 trillion with a volume of 14.28 billion shares, while 329 stocks rose, 291 fell and 168 were unchanged; six of eleven sector indices weakened, led by infrastructure down 0.40% and transport and logistics up 1.47%. PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) and PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (TPIA) posted the highest transaction values at Rp233.97 billion and Rp225.99 billion respectively, with ANTM’s price slipping 1.50% and TPIA’s climbing 3.27%. PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBRI) and PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) were among the top net foreign sell stocks, with outflows of Rp19.05 billion and Rp50.77 billion respectively.

results.title: IHSG Forecast to Test 6.633 This Week, with Analyst Recommendations for PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM), PT Dayamitra Telekomunikasi Tbk (MTEL) and PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk (IMPC).
results.body: Indo Premier Sekuritas projects the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) to test the 6,633 level this week, with support at 6,200‑6,279 and resistance at 6,585‑6,633 after the index closed at 6,441.16 below the MA5‑MA20 dead‑cross but still above the MA60. The broker recommends PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) with a target price of Rp3,710 and a stop‑loss at Rp3,110, PT Dayamitra Telekomunikasi Tbk (MTEL) with a target of Rp535 and stop‑loss at Rp484, and PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk (IMPC) with a target of Rp1,825 and stop‑loss at Rp1,630, citing solid technical structures for each. The outlook follows recent global monetary tightening, including a 25‑basis‑point Fed rate hike and a BOJ rate increase, which contributed to a 1.53% weekly decline in IHSG and net foreign outflows of Rp2.9 trillion.

results.title: Today's Stock Recommendations: ANTM, VKTR, and MAPI
results.body: The article recommends buying ANTM, VKTR, and MAPI while noting that the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed at 6,441.16, down 0.33% on 18 September 2026, with foreign investors net selling about Rp1.79 trillion. It points out that the technology sector was the only sector to gain (+0.27%) as most other sectors weakened, and that FTSE rebalancing triggered the largest net sell since 19 June, affecting micro‑cap stocks BSDE, SCMA and BBYB. Corporate updates include ERAA’s plan to expand its food‑and‑beverage portfolio through its subsidiary Erajaya Food & Nourishment (EFN), BIKE’s subsidiary Ratu Karya signing a MoU with Perumda Pasar Jaya for a Rp1 trillion Pasar Minggu development, and ULTJ’s rights issue to fund the acquisition of 100 % of Frisian Flag Indonesia for Rp14.57 trillion, after which FrieslandCampina International Holding B.V. (FCIH) will become the controlling shareholder. The rights issue will issue up to 7.88 billion new shares at Rp2,150 each, representing 43.11 % of post‑issue capital and raising up to Rp16.94 trillion, with the transaction valued at 178.24 % of ULTJ’s equity and pending approval at the RUPSLB on 27 October 2026.

results.title: Foreign investors favor PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk (BRMS), PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (EMAS) and PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI); Top 10 Net‑Buy Stocks of the Week
results.body: During the week of 14–18 September 2026, foreign investors recorded net purchases in ten Indonesian stocks, with PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk (BRMS), PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (EMAS) and PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI) leading the list. Net‑buy values were Rp324.7 billion for BRMS, Rp122.9 billion for EMAS, Rp115 billion for AADI, Rp92.3 billion for PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (AMMN), Rp74.9 billion for PT Erajaya Swasembada Tbk (ERAA), Rp43.3 billion for PT Archi Indonesia Tbk (ARCI), Rp33.3 billion for PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk (PGAS), Rp30.3 billion for PT Bukit Asam Tbk (PTBA), Rp28.9 billion for PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) and Rp22 billion for PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM). Overall foreign‑investor activity was a net sell of Rp1.84 trillion, coinciding with the IHSG index falling 1.53 % to 6,441,159, market‑capitalization decreasing 1.58 % to Rp11,266 trillion, and average daily transaction value, frequency and volume all declining. Analysts linked the market pressure to a 25‑basis‑point Fed rate hike to a 3.75‑4 % target range and expectations of further increases, which have been priced into the market.

results.title: Foreign outflow hits Rp1.79 trillion, with BBCA and BMRI leading net sells
results.body: On 18 September 2024, foreign investors recorded a net outflow of Rp1.78 trillion on the Indonesia Stock Exchange, with foreign buying rising to Rp7.04 trillion and selling to Rp8.81 trillion. The largest net‑sell positions were posted by PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) with Rp222.05 billion (35.43 million shares) and PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk (BMRI) with Rp108.93 billion (25.45 million shares), followed by PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM), PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (AMMN) and PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBRI). The top net‑buy positions were held by PT Aneka Tambang (Persero) Tbk (ANTM) at Rp41.09 billion (12.49 million shares), PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) at Rp22.40 billion (4.55 million shares), PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI) at Rp15.59 billion (1.27 million shares), PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk (MDKA) at Rp12.47 billion (4.28 million shares) and PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk (MBMA) at Rp10.48 billion (19.88 million shares). These figures show the breadth of foreign trading activity across major banks, telecom, mining and battery‑materials stocks.

results.title: IHSG Opens Weaker at Start of Week, Pressured by Global Sentiment
results.body: The IHSG opened 1.36% lower at 6,452 on Monday as rising oil prices above $100 per barrel and an 85% probability of a 25-basis-point Federal Reserve rate hike at the September 15-16 FOMC meeting pressured sentiment. Foreign investors sold a net Rp2.31 trillion in the regular market, while trading volume reached 6.53 billion shares worth Rp3.06 trillion. Technical indicators show a hammer pattern at the 6,475-6,375 support zone with the index holding above its 20-day moving average at 6,533, suggesting a potential rebound. Brokerages offered divergent outlooks: BRI Danareksa sees a constructive bias targeting resistance at 6,600-6,700 and favors UNTR, IMPC, and TINS; Phintraco expects sideways movement between 6,450-6,700 and picks ANTM, ASII, EMAS, MDKA, and ISAT; CGS International forecasts varied gains with support at 6,465-6,390 and resistance at 6,620-6,695, recommending TAPG, AALI, ISAT, TINS, AMMN, and EMAS; Panin Sekuritas anticipates further weakness due to geopolitical tensions and foreign outflows, selecting INET, BRMS, and INCO.

results.title: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk reports 34% net profit growth and higher margin in H1 2026
results.body: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk reported net profit of Rp6.9 trillion for the first half of 2026, a 34% increase year‑on‑year. Revenue rose about 6% to Rp62.7 trillion and the net profit margin expanded to 11% from 8.7% in the same period. CFO Arini Kasmira said the company will focus on optimizing gold and nickel production, cost control, and a Rp6 trillion capital expenditure program that targets EV‑battery and gold‑related projects, including a 30%‑owned HPAL project with a US$1.9 billion investment and a 40%‑owned RKEF project with a US$1.4 billion investment. The HPAL project is at final investment decision stage, while the RKEF project remains in pre‑IPC and pre‑financing phases, and a new gold‑metal facility in Gresik is slated for commercial operation by 2028.

results.title: Mirae Asset Sekuritas assesses global pressures still weighing on the market
results.body: Mirae Asset Sekuritas says global sentiment continues to weigh on Indonesia’s market, noting that the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) fell 1.33% to 6,589 amid a net foreign outflow of Rp748 billion. The pressure was most evident on banking stocks BBCA and BBRI, while foreign investors accumulated commodity‑linked shares such as ANTM, AADI, CUAN and PTBA. The firm cites macro factors including the US 10‑year Treasury yield near 5%, the ECB rate at 2.5%, high oil prices, the rupiah at roughly Rp17,547 per USD and a 10‑year SBN yield of 7.11% as limiting the transmission of global yields to the domestic market. Despite these headwinds, consumer confidence rose to 118.5 in August and Mirae Asset recommends a selective portfolio focused on strong fundamentals and solid cash flow.

results.title: Antam reports H1-2026 revenue of Rp 62.71 trillion, with gold sales exceeding Rp 50 trillion
results.body: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, Antam, reported first‑half 2026 revenue of Rp 62.71 trillion and net profit of Rp 6.91 trillion, with gold sales generating Rp 50.39 trillion, representing the majority of its earnings. Gold volume reached about 18.1 tonnes, while nickel production was 7.78 million wet metric tons and sales 6.77 million wmt. The company also highlighted its bauxite value‑chain integration, operating the Chemical Grade Alumina facility through PT Indonesia Chemical Alumina (300 k t/yr) and holding a 40 % stake in Smelter Grade Alumina Mempawah (1 M t/yr). Antam is advancing a precious‑metal manufacturing plant in Gresik with a planned capacity of 30 tonnes per year, now in pre‑construction. As of H1‑2026, total assets stood at Rp 61.27 trillion, equity at Rp 38.53 trillion and cash and equivalents at Rp 9.23 trillion.

results.title: Analysts Project Continued Strength for Metal Miners ANTM, INCO, and TINS Through Late 2026
results.body: KB Valbury Sekuritas and Phintraco Sekuritas maintain a positive outlook for PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, PT Vale Indonesia Tbk, and PT Timah Tbk for the remainder of 2026, citing solid first-half performance and supportive commodity prices. ANTM posted revenue of Rp62.7 trillion in the first half of 2026, up 6.3% year-on-year, with KB Valbury setting a target price of Rp4,000 per share on the back of a gold price rebound. INCO recorded revenue of US$543 million, a 27.3% increase, and KB Valbury assigns a Rp5,600 target price driven by rising global nickel prices and the completion of its Electric Furnace 3 rebuild in June 2026. TINS achieved 41% of its annual tin ore production target in the first half, and Phintraco highlights a global tin supply deficit of around 3% and strong demand from electronics and AI sectors as key catalysts for the second half.

results.title: UBS Sekuritas Leads Net Buying of PT Aneka Tambang Tbk Shares, While JP Morgan Issues Bullish Outlook
results.body: UBS Sekuritas led the net‑buy activity for PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) on 9 September 2026, purchasing shares at an average price of Rp3,159 and generating a net purchase value of over Rp95 billion, while CGS International Sekuritas followed with a net buy of more than Rp75 billion at an average price of Rp3,170. The heavy buying helped lift ANTM’s share price 3.91 % to Rp3,200 at the close on 9 September and a further 4 % to Rp3,330 by midday on 10 September. The activity coincided with a rebound in global spot gold to US$4,424 per troy ounce and a bullish note from JP Morgan’s Asia Pacific Equity Research, which expects an earnings upgrade for ANTM based on favorable nickel market dynamics and its strong gold‑refining business.

results.title: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas analyst highlights expansion prospects and buy recommendations for PT Bumi Resources Tbk, PT Petrosea Tbk, PT United Tractors Tbk and PT Aneka Tambang Tbk.
results.body: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas analyst Abida Massi Armand reviews the overseas mining expansion of PT Bumi Resources Tbk, PT Petrosea Tbk, PT United Tractors Tbk and PT Aneka Tambang Tbk. PT Bumi Resources Tbk, via its subsidiary Bumi Resources Australia Pty Ltd, completed the acquisition of 100% of Loyal Metals Ltd for Rp 1,004,742,244,136.50 (AUD 79,069,731.75); PT Petrosea Tbk finalized a binding offer for Tolu Minerals Limited, issuing convertible notes worth AUS $23.75 million; PT United Tractors Tbk is exploring mineral asset acquisitions in Australia; and PT Aneka Tambang Tbk is targeting gold production in the Middle East. The analyst recommends buying PT Aneka Tambang Tbk with a target price of Rp 4,900 and PT United Tractors Tbk with a target price of Rp 30,600, noting strong free cash flow and diversification benefits. He cautions that integration risks, possible overpaying and regulatory hurdles may delay profit contributions for two to three years after the deals.

results.title: Foreign investors show early signs of tactical re-entry into Indonesian equities, with analysts highlighting big banks and select sectors.
results.body: Foreign investors are showing early signs of tactical re-entry into Indonesian stocks, with net buying concentrated in large-cap banks during the week of August 31 to September 4, 2026. In that period, foreign net purchases reached Rp1.85–2.3 trillion, led by PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk, PT Bank Central Asia Tbk, PT Bank Mandiri Tbk, and PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk, which together recorded over Rp3.19 trillion of net foreign buying in the regular market. LQ45 outflows have declined sharply from over Rp15 trillion in June to under Rp2 trillion in August, and the number of LQ45 stocks with outflows fell to 27 from 36 in June. Analysts caution this is not yet a structural trend reversal, as year-to-date foreign outflows remain around US$3.94 billion, and sustainability depends on Federal Reserve policy, rupiah stability, and earnings growth. Potential rotation targets include commodity stocks ANTM, AMMN, and INCO, as well as consumer and industrial names TLKM, ASII, INDF, and UNTR, with advisors recommending accumulation on weakness.

results.title: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk Shares at Rp 3,120, Analysts Forecast Rise to Rp 4,700
results.body: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, Indonesia's state‑owned mining company, saw its shares close at Rp 3,120 on September 4, 2026, down 0.95%. Analyst Hasan Barakwan of Maybank Sekuritas Indonesia maintains a buy rating with a target price of Rp 4,700, citing strong first‑half earnings and a robust nickel business. The company posted revenue of Rp 62.7 trillion, EBITDA of Rp 8.98 trillion, and net profit of Rp 6.39 trillion in the first semester, with nickel sales up 71% quarter‑on‑quarter. Projected 2026 revenue could reach Rp 130.53 trillion and net profit Rp 9.26 trillion, driven by continued nickel volume and price gains.

results.title: Antam Gold Buyback Price Increases by Rp133,000 to Rp2.493 million per Gram on Sep 6
results.body: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk's gold buyback price rose by Rp133,000 per gram to Rp2,493,000 per gram on Sunday, 6 September 2026. The increase represents a 5.64% year‑to‑date gain from the start‑of‑year level of Rp2,360,000 per gram. Despite the rise, the price remains Rp496,000 (about 16.59%) below the all‑time high of Rp2,989,000 per gram, limiting profit potential for sellers who bought near the peak. The buyback price, set by PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, is a key indicator for investors, and under PMK No. 34/PMK.10/2017 gold sales above Rp10 million to the company are subject to a 1.5% or 3% withholding tax depending on the seller’s NPWP status.

results.title: Maybank Sekuritas Maintains Buy Rating and Rp 4,700 Target Price for PT Aneka Tambang Tbk as Nickel Business Drives Growth
results.body: Maybank Sekuritas maintained a buy recommendation and a Rp 4,700 target price for PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, citing strengthening nickel contributions that offset a normalization in gold earnings. In the first half of 2026, the company posted a 36% year-on-year increase in net profit to Rp 6.39 trillion, driven by a 420% surge in ferronickel sales volume and a 50% rise in nickel ore average selling price to US$81.6 per wet metric ton. The broker projects 2026 revenue of Rp 130.53 trillion and net profit of Rp 9.26 trillion, with nickel volume and price gains expected to counterbalance a slowdown in precious metals trading.

results.title: Stock Market Gains, Simas Syariah Unggulan Mutual Fund Posts 10.28% Return in August
results.body: Sinarmas Asset Management’s Simas Syariah Unggulan fund posted a 10.28% month‑on‑month return in August 2026, far above the average reksadana saham return of 3.60% and the IHSG index gain of 4.64% in the same period. The fund’s outperformance was driven by basic materials and consumer non‑cyclical sector strength and its top holdings of Bank Jabar Banten Syariah (18.57%), Aneka Tambang (18%), Dharma Satya Nusantara (15.01%), Archi Indonesia (12.20%) and Japfa Comfeed Indonesia (11.49%). Batavia Prosperindo Asset Management’s Batavia Dana Saham Syariah fund delivered a 6.04% month‑on‑month return, supported by energy, basic materials and infrastructure exposure, with its largest positions in Aneka Tambang (6.47%), Alamtri Resources Indonesia (5.10%), Kalbe Farma (4.29%), Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur (4.11%) and Indofood Sukses Makmur (3.73%). Both managers outlined sector‑focused strategies for the next period, with Batavia planning to increase energy exposure and Sinarmas intending to use artificial intelligence to enhance asset allocation.
